title: State plainly that all agent work, including delegation worktrees, builds, test data and scratch, stays physically inside the repository folder, and add the procedure to the repo skill
outcome: State plainly that all agent work, including delegation worktrees, builds, test data and scratch, stays physically inside the repository folder, and add the procedure to the repo skill
acceptance: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md (kept identical) say that isolated or delegation worktrees, build output, test data and scratch are always created physically inside the repository folder, and that a Git worktree outside it is no exception because it points at the repository's .git; the existing tool and install exceptions stay, narrowed so that 'TermAl through its tools' covers only TermAl's own host state

The practical procedure (explicit in-repo path for an isolated-worktree delegation when permitted, removal by the spawning parent after harvest and retained use ends, test homes under target/) is added to the existing .claude/skills/coder-test-execution/SKILL.md and its existing .agents twin, with no new skill, Greg quotes in files, Markdown-reading test or new gate

The wording agrees with Kimi::Consultant's independent comparison of both repositories and the host behavior, and lands under the authority-text procedure: both coordinators' concurrence on the exact wording, the wording and its consequence sent to Greg before landing, and the final-diff audit recorded
